exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. elective cesarean vs. emergency cesarean)
finding: CPK levels were elevated in all neonates regardless of delivery mode, suggesting that elevated CPK levels in neonates are not a specific indicator of muscular pathology.
mod_finding: Normal ranges for CPK levels differed by delivery mode: 334 U/L-2667U/L for vaginal delivery, 265U/L-1182U/L for elective cesarean, and 223U/L-3082 U/L for emergency cesarean.
